subject: english
title: Smooth Reading
objective: Read grade-level sentences accurately, smoothly, and with meaning.
introduction: Milo reads a short story aloud to Maxine. Can you help him say every word clearly, group phrases, and pause where the marks tell him?

vocabulary.definition: stop briefly when a comma or end mark tells you to pause
say every word correctly instead of guessing or skipping
read related words together as one meaningful chunk

activities.instruction: Listen for clear words, a steady pace, and meaningful expression.
activities.content: Good fluency combines accurate words, a steady pace, and expression that matches the meaning.

feedback.retry: Check whether the reading is accurate, steady, and guided by punctuation.

items.prompt: Milo reads a story aloud to his class. What should he do for smooth, meaningful reading?

options.text: Read in a flat, sleepy voice
Read as fast as you can
Read at a steady pace with meaning

items.explanation: A steady pace lets Milo say every word accurately and use expression that matches the meaning.

items.prompt: Ana reads a sentence with a period. Which action shows she is reading with meaning?

options.text: Ana reads with expression, pausing at the period.
Ana whispers so no one hears.
Ana reads without looking at the words.

items.explanation: Pausing at the period and using expression help listeners hear the sentence’s meaning.

items.prompt: Milo sees the exclamation point in “Look out!” How should he read it?
items.explanation: An exclamation point shows strong feeling, so an excited voice matches the clue.

items.prompt: Ana reads a question aloud. What should her voice do?

options.text: With a rising voice at the end

items.explanation: A question mark signals a question, so the voice rises at the end.

items.prompt: Which reading choice would sound accurate and smooth to Milo’s listener?

options.text: Reading only the first word of each line
Reading every word at an even pace

items.explanation: Reading every word correctly at an even pace supports accurate, smooth fluency.
